`bus.jpg` is the official Ultralytics example image, used to verify that the real
COCO profile detects a bus and filters out people. The aerial profile detects a
vehicle but misclassifies this street-level bus as a truck. Aerial class accuracy
is separately checked on the local user-provided overhead samples; those images
are not committed to the repository.

Source: https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/blob/main/ultralytics/assets/bus.jpg
